svg.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
svg.text: PR #1882 · Emit turn telemetry for Muse sessions
Muse sessions produced no telemetry at all — invisible in the performance views; the io task
now projects the journal through the same TurnTracker the other agents use, honestly.

g.text: muse_io_task — records in, events out, nothing kept
run_turn streamed the journal to the classifier and stopped there
no TurnTracker, no TurnOutcome, no TurnMetricsReady — the machinery
claude and codex both run was simply never wired for muse
muse absent from every metrics surface
no rows in turn_metrics, nothing in performance or history views
cross-agent comparisons silently excluded a whole agent
no per-turn duration, TTFT, tool counts, or failure states recorded
what the muse wire can and cannot say
has: model, timing, tool results, terminal state
lacks: token usage, cost, context window/occupancy
journal records → the agent-neutral projection
run.model.configured → model · first run.output.delta → TTFT
tool.result → tool_call_count · run.terminal.* → stop_reason
non-completed terminal → is_error · tracker owns the clocks
TurnTracker::start per user input; finalize emits TurnMetricsReady —
the exact path claude and codex already ride to the backend
absent means absent — no fabricated zeroes-as-data
tokens 0 (unreported), cost None, window None, snapshot None
model-less runs (echo test provider) emit nothing at all,
mirroring claude's model-less drop — views key on the model
muse joins the performance views
live and replayed sessions produce identical rows; claude/codex untouched
tests: projection, failed-terminal error case, model-less drop

svg.text: Token/cost columns for muse stay honestly empty until Meta puts usage on the wire — the projection picks it up the day the journal carries it.
